t.zh: 到这里用过的规则都看目标：结论对上目标，前提成为新目标。拆解写成规则是 ⟦?A ∧ ?B; ⟦?A; ?B⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C：结论 ?C 对得上任何目标，第一条前提 ?A ∧ ?B 却无法从目标读出，成了一个全是 ? 的目标。
t.en: The rules used so far all look at the goal: the conclusion fits it, the premises become new goals. Split as a rule is ⟦?A ∧ ?B; ⟦?A; ?B⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C: its conclusion ?C fits any goal, but its first premise ?A ∧ ?B cannot be read off the goal, and becomes a goal made of ?-letters.

t.zh: 规则从板上的「规则」输入接入；设计出的证明助手会成为新元件<part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>，这个输入就是它的「规则」口。
t.en: The rules come in at the board’s input Rules; the proof assistant you design becomes a new part, <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>, and that input is its port Rules.

becomes: Rain ∧ Wind; Rain; Wind ⊢ Wind ∧ Rain
Rain; Wet ∧ Wind; Wet; Wind ⊢ Wind ∧ Wet

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手：拆开「并且」那条已知，把每个目标变成要的样子。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes the “and” given apart, turning each goal into the one wanted.

hint.zh: 全是 ? 的目标，什么能确定它？
hint.en: What can settle a goal made of ?-letters?

hint.zh: 倒着用规则之后，紧接着用<part-ref to="part:assumption"></part-ref>。
hint.en: Right after the rule used backwards, <part-ref to="part:assumption"></part-ref>.
